capabilities: Schedule tasks with start and due dates, dependencies and a Gantt timeline with auto-scheduling
Manage tasks in table, timeline and board views with filters, saved views and bulk edit
Store each task and project as a plain Markdown note with body, properties and backlinks
Edit projects from scripts and coding agents via a local HTTP and MCP server and a CLI
Export any view to a single standalone HTML file and import existing notes as tasks
extras: The manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice; needs Obsidian 1.13 or newer; detailed docs live at an external site (docs/api.md, docs/cli.md, docs/tasknotes.md); there is no real-time collaboration, only ordinary sync conflicts.
motivation: The author built it because project tools keep the plan in one app and the thinking about it in another, and dotpm keeps both in the vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to plan projects with scheduled dates, dependencies and board or timeline views over tasks stored as regular notes.

relations.evidence: dotpm imports TaskNotes tasks with their dates, dependencies and hierarchy, and can share statuses and priorities with it.

summary: Project management over plain Markdown notes, with table, Gantt timeline and Kanban board views, dependencies, custom fields and a local MCP/HTTP API.
